scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:server
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && playwright test --config test/e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p runtime/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p contract/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:e2e:public: npm run build && playwright test --config test/e2e/public.playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:speech-real: npm run build && E2E_REAL_SPEECH=1 playwright test --config test/e2e/speech-real.playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:all: npm run test:e2e && npm run test:tts
scripts.check: npm run contract:check && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run build:tools && npm run check:boundaries && npm run test:ci && npm run test:contract && npm run test:runtime-unit && npm run test:push && npm run test:server && npm run test:consumer && npm run test:tools
scripts.check:release: npm run check && npm run test:browser
scripts.build:artifacts: npm run build && npm run build:tools
